passages.text: The Helix pack is a lithium-polymer battery built from six cells in series (6S), nominal voltage 22.2 V, rated capacity 5200 mAh.
Weight 720 g including balance lead. Dimensions 155 x 48 x 50 mm.
Discharge rating: 25C continuous, 50C burst for up to 10 s.
Recommended operating temperature: 0 °C to 50 °C. Do not charge below 5 °C.
Transport: UN38.3 test summary available on request; packs ship at 30 % state of charge.
passages.alt_text: Transport: UN38.3 testing is still in progress; packs currently ship by road only.

passages.text: Cycle life of at least 300 cycles to 80 % capacity at 1C/1C. Maximum charge rate 1C.
Output lead: 10 AWG silicone wire terminated with an XT60 connector.
passages.alt_text: Output lead: silicone wire terminated with an XT90 connector.

passages.text: Unit price: 189 EUR (minimum order 10 units).
Helix packs are hand-assembled in our ISO 9001 certified facility and come with a limited warranty.
Strata Pro: 6S1P configuration, 22.2 V nominal, 6000 mAh / 133 Wh.
Mass: 790 g. Length x width x height: 158 x 50 x 58 mm.
Maximum continuous discharge current: 120 A.
Operating range −20 °C to +60 °C (self-heating below 0 °C).
Certifications: UN38.3, IEC 62133-2, CE.
Rated for 500 cycles with at least 80 % remaining capacity. Supports 2C fast charge: full charge in about 30 min.
Integrated smart BMS with SMBus state-of-charge reporting; XT90-S anti-spark connector; IP54 enclosure.
passages.alt_text: Basic protection circuit without data interface; XT60 connector; enclosure not rated.

passages.text: List price: 349 EUR per unit.
Nordcell N6 series pack: six lithium-ion polymer cells in series, 22.2 V nominal, 4500 mAh capacity.
Weight 640 g. Size 150 x 46 x 52 mm.
Continuous discharge 15C (67.5 A), peak 30C for 5 s.
Discharge temperature range −15 °C to 50 °C; charge between 0 °C and 40 °C.
Shipping documents: UN38.3 test summary and MSDS supplied with every order. Energy below 100 Wh, so no dangerous-goods exemption is needed for air freight.
passages.alt_text: Shipping documents: MSDS supplied with every order; UN38.3 testing has not been performed yet.

passages.text: Lifetime: 400 cycles to 80 % of initial capacity. Standard charge 1C (approximately 60 min).
Supplied with XT90 connector and 8 AWG leads. Simple protection board without communication interface.
passages.alt_text: Supplied with XT60 connector. Smart BMS with SMBus state-of-charge output.

passages.text: Price: 229 EUR per unit, delivery in 3 weeks.

Only 560 g! Dimensions 140 x 44 x 48 mm.
30C continuous discharge rating.
